definitions.explanation: The tree-dwelling Australian marsupial that eats eucalyptus leaves. In Japan it is a popular zoo animal, and a well-known chocolate-filled biscuit snack is shaped like it.

コアラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: Koalas spend most of the day sleeping.
